subject: Learning Methods
title: Choosing the Right Strategy
description: A short lesson to help you apply Choosing the Right Strategy.

hook.text: She highlighted the entire textbook in yellow. It looked productive. Her exam score said otherwise.

buildup.text: Not all strategies are equal. Research ranks retrieval practice and spacing at the top. Highlighting is near the bottom.

discovery.text: Strategy selection is a metacognitive act. Matching the right strategy to the task determines efficiency.

twist.text: Students often pick strategies that feel productive over those that are effective. Effort alone is misleading.

climax.text: Before studying, ask: what does this task demand? Memorization needs retrieval practice.

punchline.text: Match strategy to task. Effort without fit is waste.

quiz.question: Why do students often choose ineffective strategies?
options: They pick strategies that feel productive rather than ones proven effective
All study strategies work equally well
